title: The $L_p$ Brunn–Minkowski Conjecture
exact_target:
For $0\leq p<1$, origin-symmetric convex bodies $K,C\subseteq\mathbb R^n$, and every $\lambda\in[0,1]$, is

$$V\bigl((1-\lambda)K+_p\lambda C\bigr)\geq V(K)^{1-\lambda}V(C)^\lambda,$$

where $+_p$ denotes the $L_p$-linear combination?
